subject: SIG/CAIQ: Request for SSO & Provisioning Evidence (SCIM delta + SAML samples)
messages:
From: Marta Sullivan <marta.sullivan@medicore.com>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
Cc: paul.england@auditors.inc
Date: Tue, 05 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG/CAIQ: Need SSO & provisioning artifacts for access section

Hi Aisha,

We're working through the SIG/CAIQ and CAIQ-lite for our upcoming SOC 2 evidence drop. Our security team and external assessor (Paul) have a few asks under the 'Access control' sections:

- A 90-day SCIM delta export (add/modify/delete events) for tenant: medi-core-prod. CSV preferred, redacted PII okay; we need mapping indicating which attributes are preserved vs hashed.
- A small sample set (5-10) of raw SAML assertion examples from production log samples (with sensitive values redacted) showing attributes and NameID format.
- A role-to-group mapping / RBAC matrix showing how roles map to groups and the enforcement point (runtime vs application).
- A service-account inventory with least-privilege justification for each entry used for provisioning or sync.

Can you share a delivery estimate and the preferred format? If there are any non-disclosure caveats or a commercial NDA required for raw assertion samples, flag that. We're targeting completing the evidence review by Aug 20.

Thanks,
Marta Sullivan
Information Security Lead
MediCore Health

--
From: aisha_rahman@redwood.com <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: Marta Sullivan <marta.sullivan@medicore.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ: Need SSO & provisioning artifacts for access section

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Priyom (IAM) and Irene (Security) so we can scope and deliver. Quick responses / plan below: 

- SCIM delta export: we can produce a 90-day delta in CSV with a column explaining redaction (we will hash user emails and user IDs). Delivery: CSV + a small README describing transformation.
- SAML assertions: we can provide 6 sampled assertions with NameID and attribute statements redacted where necessary. We usually request an NDA for full raw logs but we can provide redacted samples under current contract.
- RBAC mapping: will be a two-sheet deliverable (roles -> groups, enforcement layer).
- Service-account inventory: inventory CSV + short justification paragraph per account.

Workback & ETA: if we get confirmation this level of redaction is acceptable, we will deliver the package by Fri Aug 7 EOD PDT.

I've attached an internal checklist to show what we'll include and the redaction policy. If MediCore needs signed attestation language, let us know.

Next steps: please confirm (1) acceptance of redaction/hash approach, and (2) whether the assessor (Paul) needs the raw logs under an NDA.

Regards,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
Cell: +1 415-555-0148
Redwood Inference

Attachment: iam-evidence-checklist_v1.pdf

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Marta Sullivan <marta.sullivan@medicore.com>, aisha_rahman@redwood.com
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 06 Aug 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ: Need SSO & provisioning artifacts for access section

Hi Marta / Paul — I’m Priyom from Redwood’s IAM team. Following up with the artifact plan and what we will attach on Aug 7. Summary of what we'll deliver:

1) SCIM-delta-202605-202608.csv (attached) — 90-day delta with event type (create/update/delete), timestamp (UTC), object_type, target_id (hashed), and attribute_change_summary. We include a small mapping file describing which attributes were redacted vs preserved.

2) saml-assertion-samples.txt (attached) — 6 redacted samples; we retain attribute names and element structure but redact sensitive attribute values and NameID where identifiability exists. Each sample includes a header with capture timestamp and SP/IdP IDs.

3) service-account-inventory-202608.csv (attached) — CSV listing account_id (masked), owner team, last-used, scope (API-only / full-provision), and justification for least privilege.

4) rbac-mapping.pdf — concise mapping: role -> group -> enforcement point (runtime enforcer or application layer).

Notes on redaction: we hashed user IDs with a salted HMAC and removed email addresses in samples. If you require plaintext for a small subset for correlation to your logs, we can do a controlled reveal under a mutual NDA / secure ShareFile exchange.

We will also include a short narrative describing how SCIM is triggered (delta intervals), how the SCIM sync handles deletions, and the retention window for SCIM logs.

Attachment list included with email: SCIM-delta-202605-202608.csv; saml-assertion-samples.txt; service-account-inventory-202608.csv; rbac-mapping.pdf

Happy to hop on a 20–30 minute call to walk through artifacts. Proposed slots: Thu Aug 7 between 09:00–12:00 PDT.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Principal IAM Engineer
Redwood Inference

- Please include a short statement confirming SCIM retention windows and the last-backup timestamp for provisioning logs.
- We’ll take the proposed Thu Aug 7, 09:30–09:55 PDT slot for a quick walkthrough. I’ll send a calendar invite; Paul will join as well.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
